name: Fitzen (Germany)
description: White field with narrow red stripes along the hoist and fly edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Fitzen (a cow on blue above a crayfish on red, divided by a white wavy bend).
history: Municipal flag of Fitzen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Fitzen arms — cow, crayfish and wavy bend
